name: helptester
description: Browser-based hardware tests, network checks (IP, speed) and developer tools from HelpTester: keyboard, mouse, gamepad, microphone, MIDI, touchscreen and speaker tests, IP address and internet speed checks, JSON formatter, Base64, QR code generator, DNS checker and AI Unicode remover.

interface.longDescription: Browser-based hardware tests (keyboard, mouse, gamepad, microphone, MIDI, touchscreen, speaker), network checks (public IP, ISP, latency, internet speed) and developer tools (JSON formatter, Base64, QR code generator, DNS checker, AI Unicode remover) as interactive widgets inside ChatGPT. Tests that need the full browser open on helptester.com.
defaultPrompt: Use HelpTester to test my keyboard for stuck or dead keys.
Use HelpTester to generate a QR code for https://helptester.com.
